descriptionByLocale.it:
Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD übernimmst du eine praxisnahe und verantwortungsvolle Rolle bei der Energieversorgung des Landes. In dieser Position trägst du entscheidend dazu bei, die Zuverlässigkeit und Lebensdauer unserer Leistungstransformatoren in der gesamten Schweiz zu sichern und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Zudem bringst du die Motivation mit, an internen Workshops und Schulungen zur Transformatorenmontage sowie an Außendiensteinsätzen teilzunehmen – inklusive eines strukturierten Onboardings und weiterführender Trainings in den Hitachi-Energy-Werken. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen sowie vorbeugenden und korrektiven Wartungsarbeiten, Inspektionen und Überholungen an Leistungstransformatoren gemäß internen Verfahren Anwendung und Durchsetzung der Sicherheitsstandards von Hitachi Energy bei allen Einsätzen Planung, Koordination und Optimierung von Außendiensteinsätzen zur Sicherstellung von Effizienz und Qualität Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten, sowie Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit unseren Anlagen Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über unsere neuen Anlagen und Technologien Aktive Mitwirkung an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen innerhalb der Serviceorganisation Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung in Mechanik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. Schlosser, Mechaniker, Polymechaniker, Automatiker) Ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und hohe Sensibilität für Sicherheitsanforderungen Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Außendienst im Bereich Service oder Wartung von Großanlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche wünschenswert Kenntnisse in elektrischer Verkabelung und Schaltplänen, sowie Schweißkenntnisse von Vorteil Bereitschaft zu längeren Einsätzen innerhalb der Schweiz (mindestens 1 Woche) Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'OPPORTUNITÀ
• Stiamo cercando un Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager lungimirante per PCS (Power Conversion Systems) per accelerare la nostra crescita in tutto il mercato europeo. In questo ruolo strategico, collegherai i nostri team di vendita GPG, i responsabili del mercato regionale e l'organizzazione delle vendite front-end (FES), garantendo il pieno allineamento sulla nostra strategia Go-to-Market e rafforzando al contempo la nostra impronta commerciale. Se sei appassionato di guidare l'espansione del mercato, abilitare team di vendita ad alte prestazioni e costruire un solido ecosistema di partner per soluzioni innovative di conversione di potenza, questo ruolo ti offre l'opportunità di avere un impatto significativo in tutta Europa. Come avere un impatto Guidare ed eseguire la strategia Go‑to‑Market per i PC in tutta Europa Allineare le priorità tra GPG, Market Manager HUB e FES per garantire un approccio commerciale unificato Tradurre le tendenze di mercato e le intuizioni competitive in strategie commerciali attuabili Agire come connettore centrale tra i team di vendita e abilitarli con esperienza di prodotto e strumenti di vendita di valore Generare lead qualificati ed espandere la pipeline dei PC attraverso campagne e coinvolgimento dei partner Identificare, integrare e consentire ai partner ad alto potenziale di scalare le soluzioni dei PC in tutta Europa Controllare la gestione della pipeline, l'accuratezza delle previsioni e le revisioni mensili delle prestazioni Fornire approfondimenti commerciali basati sui dati per supportare il processodecisionale strategico a livello di leadership GPG Il tuo background Comprovato track record in Business
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity We are looking for a forward‑thinking Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager for PCS (Power Conversion Systems) to accelerate our growth across the European market. In this strategic role, you will connect our GPG sales teams, Regional Market Managers, and Front‑End Sales (FES) organization - ensuring full alignment on our Go‑to‑Market strategy while strengthening our commercial footprint. If you are passionate about driving market expansion, enabling high‑performing sales teams, and building a strong partner ecosystem for innovative power conversion solutions, this role offers you the opportunity to make a significant impact across Europe. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute the Go‑to‑Market strategy for PCS across Europe Align priorities across GPG, HUB Market Managers, and FES to ensure a unified commercial approach Translate market trends and competitive insights into actionable commercial strategies Act as the central connector across sales teams and enable them with product expertise and value‑selling tools Generate qualified leads and expand the PCS pipeline through campaigns and partner engagement Identify, onboard, and enable high‑potential partners to scale PCS solutions across Europe Oversee pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and monthly performance reviews Provide data‑driven commercial insights to support strategic decision‑making at GPG leadership level Your background Proven track record in Business Development, Sales Enablement, or Commercial Management, ideally in a technical or industrial environment Strong understanding of Go‑to‑Market models, channel\/partner ecosystems, and value‑based selling Experienced in building relationships with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders Confident in market analysis, sales forecasting, and managing complex commercial pipelines Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage A strategic thinker with hands‑on execution capability and a strong sense of ownership Customer‑centric mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast‑moving, international environment More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen zukunftsorientierten Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager für PCS (Power Conversion Systems), um unser Wachstum auf dem europäischen Markt zu beschleunigen. In dieser strategischen Rolle verbinden Sie unsere GPG-Vertriebsteams, regionalen Marktmanager und die Front-End-Vertriebsorganisation (FES) und stellen so eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf unsere Markteinführungsstrategie sicher und stärken gleichzeitig unsere kommerzielle Präsenz. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, die Marktexpansion voranzutreiben, leistungsstarke Vertriebsteams zu unterstützen und ein starkes Partner-Ökosystem für innovative Energieumwandlungslösungen aufzubauen, bietet Ihnen diese Rolle die Möglichkeit, einen erheblichen Einfluss in ganz Europa zu nehmen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen und die Markteinführungsstrategie für PCS in ganz Europa umsetzen Richten Sie Prioritäten für GPG, HUB Market Manager und FES aus, um einen einheitlichen kommerziellen Ansatz zu gewährleisten Übersetzen Sie Markttrends und Wettbewerbseinblicke in umsetzbare kommerzielle Strategien Handeln Sie als zentraler Konnektor für Vertriebsteams und ermöglichen Sie ihnen mit Produktkompetenz und Value-Selling-Tools Generieren Sie qualifizierte Leads und erweitern Sie die PCS-Pipeline durch Kampagnen und Partner-Engagement Identifizieren, integrieren und ermöglichen Sie potenziellen Partnern, PCs-Lösungen in ganz Europa zu skalieren Überwachen Sie das Pipeline-Management, die Prognosegenauigkeit und die monatlichen Leistungsüberprüfungen Stellen Sie datengesteuerte kommerzielle Erkenntnisse bereit, um strategische Entscheidungen auf GPG-Führungsebene zu unterstützen Ihr Hintergrund Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Geschäft
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Business Development & Sales Activement Manager pour PCS (Power Conversion Systems) pour accélérer notre croissance sur le marché européen. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous connecterez nos équipes de vente GPG, les gestionnaires régionaux du marché et l'organisation des ventes de première ligne (FES) afin de s'aligner pleinement sur notre stratégie Go‐to‐Market tout en renforçant notre empreinte commerciale. Si vous êtes passionné par l'expansion du marché, la création d'équipes de vente performantes et la construction d'un écosystème partenaire solide pour des solutions innovantes de conversion de puissance, ce rôle vous offre l'occasion d'avoir un impact significatif dans toute l'Europe. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez et exécutez la stratégie Go-to-Market pour les SCP en Europe Alignez les priorités à l'échelle de GPG, HUB Market Managers et FES pour assurer une approche commerciale unifiée Traduire les tendances du marché et les perspectives concurrentielles en stratégies commerciales réalisables Agir en tant que connecteur central à l'échelle des équipes de vente et leur permettre d'avoir une expertise produit et des outils de vente de valeur Générer des pistes qualifiées et élargir le pipeline PCS par le biais de campagnes et de l'engagement des partenaires Identifier, à bord, et permettre aux partenaires à haut potentiel d'évaluer les solutions PCS à l'échelle de l'Europe Superviser la gestion des pipelines, la prévision de l'exactitude et les évaluations mensuelles des performances Fournir des informations commerciales fondées sur les données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des GPG Votre contexte Expérience éprouvée en matière d'analyse des marchés, de prévision des ventes et de gestion commerciale, idéalement dans un environnement technique ou industriel Une bonne compréhension des modèles Go-to-Market, des écosystèmes de canaux/partenaires et des ventes fondées sur la valeur Expérience de l'établissement de relations avec des équipes Nous voulons que vous prospérez vraiment avec nous, dans le travail et dehors.

title: Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence - BU Transformers

titleByLocale.it: Dati globali, analisi e intelligenza artificiale - BU Transformers
titleByLocale.en: Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence - BU Transformers
titleByLocale.de: Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence - BU Transformers
titleByLocale.fr: Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence - BU Transformers

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Manager for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team shaping the future of energy through digital innovation, data‑driven insights, and AI‑enabled solutions. In this role, you will drive data‑ and AI‑enabled value creation by converting business strategy into prioritized AI initiatives, ensuring measurable impact across operations, decision‑making, and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to grow your career within the newly established Digital Transformation Organization, collaborate with global stakeholders, and shape the future of Transformer solutions. How you will make an impact Shape the future of data, analytics, and AI by setting a clear strategic direction that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale. Turn real business challenges into AI opportunities that improve decisions, performance, and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high‑impact AI portfolio, taking ideas from early concepts to scaled solutions that create measurable value. Champion responsible and trusted AI by embedding strong governance, ethics, and data standards into everything delivered. Elevate data as a strategic asset by improving quality, consistency, and access to enable powerful insights and AI solutions. Lead diverse, cross‑functional teams to deliver AI initiatives that are practical, scalable, and business‑ready. Learn from results to continuously refine approaches, scale successes, and amplify business impact. Build strong partnerships with business and digital leaders to align priorities and accelerate AI adoption. Strengthen organizational capabilities through targeted learning, clear messaging, and a strong data‑driven mindset. Drive change with confidence by guiding stakeholders through transformation and ensuring responsible adoption of new solutions. Inspire, develop, and grow high‑performing Data, Analytics, and AI teams aligned behind a shared vision. Your background Master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CAIP, advanced AI\/ML certifications) highly valued. Minimum 15+ years of experience in roles related to business process management or program implementation in the manufacturing industry. Effective communication skills with a proven ability to engage diverse stakeholders at all levels, fostering a collaborative environment to drive initiatives. Demonstrated competence in influencing and motivating teams to adopt new processes, reduce resistance, and achieve successful transitions to globally harmonized practices. Deep understanding of data, analytics, AI\/GenAI technologies, machine learning and analytics platforms. Strong analytical skills to tackle complex data and\/or AI challenges. Awareness of ethical considerations in AI development and deployment. Ability to bridge strategy, governance, and execution.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all! How you'll make an impact You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

title: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication

titleByLocale.it: Lead del processo di produzione globale - Fabbricazione di nuclei di trasformatori
titleByLocale.en: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication
titleByLocale.de: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication
titleByLocale.fr: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity The Global Manufacturing Process Lead - GPG DT - Transformer Cores Fabrication is responsible for defining, leading, and continuously improving the end-to-end engineering and manufacturing-related processes for transformers magnetic cores within the Global Product Group (GPG), covering distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, and traction transformers. This role has a strong focus on core manufacturing processes, including lamination handling, cutting, stacking, core assembly, clamping, insulation interfaces, losses control, dimensional accuracy, and industrialization readiness, ensuring alignment between design, manufacturing, suppliers, and digital platforms. The position supports the “Design Anywhere, Manufacture Anywhere” strategy by standardizing processes, enabling digital tools, and ensuring that best practices in core manufacturing engineering are consistently deployed across factories worldwide. The role drives Lean, Digital Transformation, and Value Stream improvements, ensuring speed, quality, and robustness of magnetic core processes while reducing manual activities and variability. Close collaboration with Factory Engineering Process Managers, Digital Transformation Leads, Platform\/Tool teams, and Supply Chain is essential. How you'll make an impact You own global engineering and manufacturing processes for magnetic cores. You set clear standards that ensure quality, consistency, and efficiency. You standardize how cores are designed, built, and assembled worldwide. You ensure processes scale across factories and production volumes. You review processes regularly and drive continuous improvement. You improve efficiency, quality, and lead times through structured improvements. You identify where automation and digital tools add real value. You define requirements for tools that support design and manufacturing. You connect engineering with operations, supply chain, and suppliers. You lead a global network that applies standards safely and consistently. Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.

You will collaborate with crossfunctional teams ensuring that Foundation APQP essentials are updated according to novelties and new risks. How you´ll make an impact Coordinate the development of Foundation APQP plan. Lead foundation APQP Plan related meetings, collecting and preparing documentation, being main connection point between QMT, Factories, Global experts and R&D. Participate in Foundation FMEA workshops and s upport HUBs and Factories to use foundation APQP essentials (to be cascaded to local products). Support R&D organization to use foundation APQP essentials for new product developments. Support ToT projects to ensure proper transfer of APQP essentials. Act as GPG I&C Plato Admin, train crossfunctional teams, support the organization on the usage and ensure that foundation content is updated . Proactive identification of technology novelties to drive updates in foundation APQP essentials and c ollaborate with GPG Operations to identify global process changes that might affect to foundation APQP essentials ( e.g. from best practices to requirement). title: Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems - Europe

titleByLocale.it: Gestione unità operativa per sistemi di automazione sottostazione - Europa

titleByLocale.de: Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems - Europe
titleByLocale.fr: Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems - Europe

descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity As the Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, performance, and growth of our Substation Automation portfolio across the region. You will oversee all commercial, operational, and technical aspects of the HUB, ensuring excellence in project execution, customer satisfaction, and business results. This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions. Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully .* * A pplicable   only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptionByLocale.it: Über die Position Als Mitarbeiter Endprüfung bei Hitachi Energy bist du ein entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Produktion und Auslieferung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte vor der Freigabe höchsten Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Dokumentationsanforderungen entsprechen. Mit deinem Qualitätsbewusstsein und deinem strukturierten Vorgehen trägst du maßgeblich zur Zuverlässigkeit unserer Produkte und zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden bei. Das kannst du bewirken Testen von Generatorleistungsschaltern im Prüffeld (80%): Prüfen der Generator Leistungsschalter gemäss vorgegebenem Prüfplan Bewertung der Messergebnisse Durchführung von Kundenabnahmen in Englischer Sprache Erkennen von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern Analyse und Korrektur von Verdrahtungsfehlern im Steuerschrank Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Prüfen der zugeteilten Schalter (zeitlicher Ablauf sowie Qualität der Prüfung) Mitarbeit bei der Verbesserung des Messequipments sowie der Prüfprozesse Montage- und Verdrahtungsarbeiten (20%): Selbstständige Verdrahtung von Baugruppen und Schaltersystemen gemäss Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenauftrag, Elektroschema, Checkliste und Arbeits­plan Montage von PGHV-Produkten entsprechend der in den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen Lesen und verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (Automatiker EFZ, o.ä.) Erfahrung im lesen und verstehen von elektrischen Schemas, Montagezeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen Kenntnisse der Prüfung elektrischer Maschinen und von Steuerschränken sind von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mündlich, schriftlich) Affinität zu Computern (Messequipment, diverse Softwaretools, Dokumentation erstellen und pflegen) Gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie kundenorientiertes Denken und professioneller Umgang mit Kunden Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity We are looking for a Project Manager to strengthen our Team in our Business Unit Transformers, Ticino. In this role you are leading the execution of medium-size projects mainly related to LV & MV Transformers and Reactors and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policy, quality standards, health & safety and environment requirements. Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Please submit your resume in English. How you'll make an impact Developing project schedules, and determining resource requirements Monitoring and reporting on the status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing Ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards (e.g., International Standards Organization) Manage After-Sales projects by ensuring the fulfillment of customer needs Identifying\/resolving obstacles to completing project on time and to budget May include work managing multiple, interrelated projects (including business transformation projects) On some projects, the work may include integrating vendor tasks into the project plan and tracking and reviewing vendor deliverables Your background Electrical Engineering or mechanical Engineering Background 2-3 years proven experience in Project Management with focus on Transformers and Reactors Collaboration with diverse number of stakeholders Very good knowledge of English and Italian; any other languages are a plus Strong communicator, self-driven and open-minded Structured and organized person with the ability to work under time pressure Team-player able to build and motivate a project team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken English Team player and well organized Creative and able to work autonomously Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it: In Hitachi, stiamo plasmando il futuro con precisione, innovazione e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. Per il nostro stabilimento produttivo a Wettingen, cerchiamo una persona impegnata ed esperta come Responsabile Logistico Merci in Uscita, che gestisca l'intero processo di spedizione con una panoramica e un senso di responsabilità. In questo ruolo chiave, garantirai che i nostri prodotti raggiungano i nostri clienti puntualmente, completi e in perfette condizioni – e quindi contribuiranno in modo decisivo all'affidabilità della consegna e alla soddisfazione del cliente. Cosa puoi fare Gestione e coordinamento di tutte le attività in uscita, inclusi prelievo, confezione, carico e spedizione Ottimizzazione dei processi di magazzinaggio e logistica in uscita per aumentare l'efficienza e ridurre i costi Leadership, motivazione e ulteriore sviluppo del team uscente Garantire la conformità agli standard di qualità, alle normative di sicurezza e ai requisiti legali Responsabilità per l'accuratezza dell'inventario nel reparto merci in uscita Merci in uscita e gestione regolare degli inventari. Stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti interni (produzione, acquisti, vendite), nonché con partner logistici esterni e spedizionieri. Analisi delle figure chiave rilevanti e preparazione di rapporti sulle prestazioni delle merci in uscita, identificazione e implementazione del potenziale di miglioramento, nonché introduzione di nuove tecnologie, garantire una gestione fluida delle formalità doganali ed esportazione. Il tuo background: Formazione completata in logistica, gestione della catena di approvvigionamento o una qualifica comparabile (ad esempio specialista logistico con un indirizzo federale. Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in posizioni manageriali nel settore merci in uscita o logistica, idealmente in un'azienda manifatturiera Solida conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione magazzino (WMS) e dei sistemi ERP (ad esempio SAP) Esperienza nella guida di team e forti abilità sociali Solide capacità analitiche e concettuali nonché alto livello di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e capacità di problem solving Fluente in tedesco scritto e parlato (Il tedesco svizzero è un vantaggio) e buone competenze in inglese Familiarità con le normative svizzere sulle esportazioni e le dogane Flessibilità negli orari di lavoro se necessario Maggiori informazioni sui nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere Versione tedesca sotto Responsabile della Logistica Outbound 80–100% (f\/m\/d) Informazioni sulla posizione Presso Hitachi, Stiamo plasmando il futuro—con precisione, forza innovativa e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. Per il nostro sito produttivo a Wettingen, cerchiamo una persona impegnata ed esperta come Manager della Logistica Outbound che, con una forte panoramica e senso di responsabilità, gestisca l'intero processo di spedizione. In questo ruolo chiave, vi assicurate che i nostri prodotti raggiungano i clienti puntualmente, in condizioni complete e in perfette condizioni—contribuendo in modo decisivo all'affidabilità della consegna e alla soddisfazione del cliente. descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Business Unit Service is at the forefront of delivering advanced, reliability-driven service solutions worldwide. As we evolve from descriptive monitoring toward scalable predictive and prescriptive intelligence, reliability modelling becomes a cornerstone of how we create customer value across the asset lifecycle. As Senior Reliability Specialist, you will take an enterprise level role in shaping how reliability intelligence is defined, governed, and applied across our global digital service portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of reliability engineering, digital platforms, and service strategy, ensuring that reliability models are scientifically robust, consistently governed, scalable, and reusable—while being directly connected to operational performance and commercial outcomes. This is a senior, high impact role for an expert who wants to influence how reliability intelligence is used across an entire organization, not just within a single product or project. How you'll make an impact Define and implement the enterprise reliability modelling strategy across BU Service Ensure reliability models deliver consistent, explainable, and decision relevant outputs (e.g., PoF, RUL, risk, mitigation) used in customer facing and decision critical contexts Coordinate companywide projects and activities to harmonize reliability methods and avoid duplication Govern reliability model development, validation, deployment, and retirement Drive integration of reliability models into digital service and predictive platforms Partner with digital, analytics, and IT\/OT teams on data driven reliability solutions Establish standards, guidelines, and training programs for reliability engineering Define and track KPIs and deliver executive insights on reliability performance and maturity Your background Master's or PhD degree in Engineering (Reliability, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or related) Proven experience in reliability engineering and reliability modelling in mission‑critical environments Strong expertise in failure analysis, reliability modelling, and asset health management methods Experience coordinating or governing technical or modelling activities across multiple teams or units Confidence to work effectively in complex IT\/OT environments with multiple stakeholders Ability to translate reliability insights into operational decisions and service performance outcomes More about us
• We offer a highly collaborative environment across engineering, digital, analytics, and service teams A senior, visible role shaping the future of reliability intelligence in global digital services Continuous learning through exposure to leading reliability, predictive, and digital service practices Flexible working practices that help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity As high voltage lab engineer , you are a full member of a dynamic team of scientists and technicians working to shape the future technology to be used in high voltage products. In this position, you can test innovative ideas, implement new measurement and diagnostics methods, while you maintain a functional and safe testing environment . Come and join our team if you are interested in the field of high voltage technology and work towards a sustainable and exciting future in energy. How you will make an impact: Run and maintain state-of-the-art high voltage labs Participate actively in planning, preparation and execution of high voltage tests Collaborate closely with a team of scientists and technicians from research Bring your active contribution to the definition of safe testing practices in the lab during all phases of the experiments with the support of local HSE partners and research team Interact with partners in the adjacent Hitachi Energy high voltage labs and business units. W hat you will bring: Education in electrical engineering with at least a bachelor degree (FH) Proven experience in lab work, including experimental setup with advanced measurement methods Knowledge of lab integrated programming using LabView, Matlab or Python is very much welcome Skills in data analysis are a plus. Past experience in high voltage lab is advantageous . Conversational level in English is required, good knowledge of German language is very appreciated. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

descriptionByLocale.it: Possibilità Siamo alla ricerca di un esecutivo dinamico ed esperto per l'acquisto che rafforza il nostro team di assistenza dedicato a Hitachi, Ltd., dove velocità e qualità sono della massima importanza. La vostra esperienza garantisce un approvvigionamento rapido e conveniente di beni e servizi, mantenendo al contempo i più elevati standard di qualità e promuovendo rapporti di partnership a lungo termine con i fornitori. descriptionByLocale.en: The Possibility We are looking for a dynamic and experienced executive for purchasing that strengthens our dedicated service team at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are of the utmost importance. In this key position, you conduct strategic purchasing initiatives, optimize procurement processes and run a talented team of around 12 shopping experts. Your expertise ensures a fast and cost-effective procurement of goods and services while maintaining the highest quality standards and promoting long-term, partnership relationships with suppliers. This allows you to take over the leadership, promotion and further development of our purchasing team and create a performance-oriented and responsible corporate culture. They develop and implement innovative procurement concepts in accordance with our service strategy. In doing so, you place particular emphasis on timely delivery, continuous quality improvement, efficiency improvement in the supply chain and sustainable cost reduction. The application of the Critical-Path method to ensure timely procurement processes and to minimize delivery delays is one of your core tasks. They ensure consistent excellence throughout the entire purchasing process – from demand determination to payment – and ensure clear processes and maximum transparency. They define and control supplier segmentation and develop targeted procurement strategies. In addition, you are responsible for the selection, qualification and contract negotiations with suppliers. By building strategic partnerships at leadership level and establishing robust supplier management systems with KPIs, scorecards, regular reviews and escalation processes, you can ensure the sustainable performance of our supplier network. They work closely with cross-departmental teams such as material planning, engineering, quality and controlling, in order to optimally tune the purchase to the corporate requirements. They control purchase-related risks, including supply chain disruptions, price fluctuations and compliance issues. This brings you with completed studies in the field of supply chain management, business management, engineering or comparable training with relevant professional experience. At least 5 years of relevant experience in purchasing or supply chain management or at least 3 years of leadership experience in a related area. Detectable successes in strategic purchasing, in negotiations and in supplier or customer management are advantageous. Very good understanding of purchasing processes, contract law and principles of the supply chain. Impressed analytical skills as well as problem-solving and decision-making. Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Very good knowledge of purchasing software (e.g. SAP Ariba) and Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment and manage multiple priorities. Experience in manufacturing, technology or industry is very desirable. Our flexible work models help you to optimize personal and business performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow. Ils définissent et contrôlent la segmentation des fournisseurs et élaborent des stratégies d'approvisionnement ciblées. De plus, vous êtes responsable de la sélection, de la qualification et des négociations contractuelles avec les fournisseurs. En établissant des partenariats stratégiques au niveau du leadership et en mettant en place des systèmes robustes de gestion des fournisseurs avec des ICR, des cartes de pointage, des examens réguliers et des processus d'escalade, vous pouvez assurer la performance durable de notre réseau de fournisseurs. Ils travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interministérielles telles que la planification des matériaux, l'ingénierie, la qualité et le contrôle, afin d'adapter au mieux l'achat aux exigences de l'entreprise. Ils contrôlent les risques liés aux achats, y compris les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les fluctuations des prix et les problèmes de conformité. Cela vous amène avec des études terminées dans le domaine de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la gestion d'entreprise, de l'ingénierie ou une formation comparable avec une expérience professionnelle pertinente. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en gestion des achats ou de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou au moins 3 ans d'expérience en leadership dans un domaine connexe. Les succès détectés dans les achats stratégiques, les négociations et la gestion des fournisseurs ou des clients sont avantageux. Très bonne compréhension des processus d'achat, du droit des contrats et des principes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Des compétences analytiques réduites ainsi que la résolution de problèmes et la prise de décisions. Excellente communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles. Très bonne connaissance des logiciels d'achat (par exemple SAP Ariba) et Microsoft Office, en particulier Excel. Capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international accéléré et de gérer de multiples priorités. L'expérience dans la fabrication, la technologie ou l'industrie est très souhaitable. Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent se développer et croître. descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. We are currently seeking a skilled and highly motivated candidate to join our CDSe (Common Design System Electrical) team as a CDSe Domain Expert for Liquid and Dry Transformers. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in the development and enhancement of the distribution transformer electrical design platform , ensuring it meets the highest standards of performance, reliability, and efficiency. How You'll Make An Impact Support CDSe development and maintenance by aligning with technical standards and technological advancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement new features. Prepare software specifications, collaborate with developers on implementation, and verify the accuracy of implemented features.Develop test cases to ensure the sustainable quality of the CDS platform and lead test sessions with end users. Conduct thorough testing and validation of the design platform to ensure accuracy and reliability.Perform comparative analysis of calculated and tested transformer parameters, identify root causes of discrepancies, and propose effective solutions. Provide technical support, prepare training materials, and deliver training sessions to end users.Monitor hotline requests and act on user feedback to improve the platform's performance.Work closely with Hub Engineering teams to accelerate CDS implementation in factories. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies and incorporate them into the platform. Be part of a multicultural, globally distributed CDS community and propose innovative solutions. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in the design of dry-type or liquid transformers. Strong knowledge of design principles, materials, manufacturing, and testing of transformers.Awareness of different transformer technologies. Experience in or interest in software development (e.g., macro development, Excel automation tools). Proactive, self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership.Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills & Ability to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary team. Strong communication skills, with good verbal and written English proficiency. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us in work and out.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Join our dynamic Business R&D team in Turgi, where we develop cutting-edge medium-voltage frequency converters and HVDC subsystems. You'll work in a collaborative environment with six power electronics engineers and three mechanical engineers, contributing to innovative solutions that have a global impact. This position combines 60% R&D and 40% production engineering, offering flexibility for research activities and hands-on involvement in manufacturing processes. How you'll make an impact
• Research & Development (60%) Drive innovation in medium-voltage converter design and technology Develop and build from prototype until the final product Collaborate with global teams in Poland, Sweden, India and China Work arrangement: Flexible (remote or on-site as needed)
• Production Engineering (40%) Ensure seamless integration of designs into manufacturing processes Optimize production workflows for efficiency and quality Provide technical support to production teams and troubleshoot issues Work arrangement: On-site presence required at our factories in Turgi and Seon Lead & implement lean management and CIP methodology Your background Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field Experience in power electronics and converter technology Experience in mechanical design and development, with tools like SolidEdge, NX, SAP Knowledge of production processes and industrialization Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Fluent in English and German What We Offer Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità The GPG Standardization Lead sarà responsabile della definizione e della guida della strategia di standardizzazione in tutto il Global Product Group (GPG). Il GPG Standardization Lead lavorerà a stretto contatto con diverse unità di business, team di ingegneria e dipartimenti della supply chain per garantire l'implementazione efficiente delle pratiche di standardizzazione, che sono fondamentali per migliorare la disponibilità dei materiali, accelerare i processi di approvvigionamento e sfruttare le economie di scala in un mercato in rapida crescita. Sviluppare e guidare una strategia di standardizzazione completa a livello GPG, in collaborazione con business unit (BU) e HUB regionali. Assicurarsi che la strategia si allinei con obiettivi organizzativi e richieste di mercato. Migliorare la standardizzazione delle parti, quantificare la standardizzazione e i costi associati. Definire i criteri per la standardizzazione e i criteri per la creazione di nuove parti in collaborazione con team di ingegneria e supply chain Sviluppare dashboard visivi per metriche di ingegneria come Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacità, qualità, metriche Sviluppo di strumenti di ricerca, per migliorare il riutilizzo di parti e componenti esistenti; implementare la piattaforma di progettazione di funzionalità relative alla standardizzazione Creare e mantenere una libreria di specifiche e regole basata sui profili dei clienti per guidare la standardizzazione tra le fabbriche. Accetto su quali elementi da PLM (windchill) per connettersi a strumenti di progettazione. Stabilire metodi per quantificare, misurare e migliorare le pratiche di standardizzazione. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali di Hitachi Energy di sicurezza e integrità, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità per le proprie azioni, mentre la cura per i vostri colleghi e il business Il vostro background Bachelor \ / Master in Ingegneria è preferito. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in ingegneria con un focus sulla standardizzazione. Provato record di traccia nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di standardizzazione. Forte comprensione dei processi di approvvigionamento e della gestione dei materiali. Esperienza con dashboard di ingegneria e metriche. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione per lavorare con team interfunzionali. Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving. Il pensiero strategico e la pianificazione. Familiarità con il software PLM (PTC Windchill è preferito) La competenza nei principi e nelle pratiche di standardizzazione. Conoscenza della mappatura del flusso di valore (VSM) e altre metriche di ingegneria. Familiarità con GMR\/Windchill e altri strumenti di progettazione. Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto. È richiesta la competenza in lingua inglese parlata e scritta
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity The GPG Standardization Lead will be responsible for defining and driving the standardization strategy across the Global Product Group (GPG). The GPG Standardization Lead will work closely with various business units, engineering teams, and supply chain departments to ensure the efficient implementation of standardization practices, which are critical to enhancing material availability, speeding up procurement processes, and leveraging economies of scale in a rapidly growing market. How you'll make an impact Develop and drive a comprehensive standardization strategy at the GPG level, in collaboration with business unit (BU) and regional HUBs. Ensure the strategy aligns with organizational goals and market demands. Enhance the standardization of parts by quantifying standardization and associated costs. Define criteria for standardization and criteria for new part creation in collaboration with engineering and supply chain teams Develop visual dashboards for engineering metrics such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacity, quality, metrics Drive development of search tools, to improve reuse of existing parts and components; drive implementation in design platform of features related to standardization Create and maintain a specification and rules library based on customer profiles to drive standardization among factories. Agree on which items from PLM (windchill) to connect to design tools. Establish methods for quantifying, measuring, and improving standardization practices. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's \/ Master's degree in Engineering is preferred. Minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering with a focus on standardization. Proven track record in developing and implementing standardization strategies. Strong understanding of procurement processes and material management. Experience with engineering dashboards and metrics. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strategic thinking and planning. Familiarity with PLM software (PTC Windchill is preferred) Proficiency in standardization principles and practices. Knowledge of Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and other engineering metrics. Familiarity with GMR\/Windchill and other design tools. Strong organizational and project management skills. Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Möglichkeit Die GPG-Standardisierung Lead wird für die Definition und Steuerung der Standardisierungsstrategie in der Global Product Group (GPG) verantwortlich sein. Der GPG Standardization Lead wird eng mit verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, Ingenieurteams und Supply Chain Abteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um die effiziente Umsetzung von Standardisierungspraktiken zu gewährleisten, die für die Verbesserung der Materialverfügbarkeit, die Beschleunigung der Beschaffungsprozesse und die Nutzung von Skaleneffekten in einem schnell wachsenden Markt entscheidend sind. Wie Sie eine Wirkung entfalten und eine umfassende Standardisierungsstrategie auf der GPG-Ebene in Zusammenarbeit mit Business Unit (BU) und regionalen HUBs vorantreiben. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Strategie auf organisatorische Ziele und Marktanforderungen ausgerichtet ist. Verbessern Sie die Standardisierung von Teilen durch Quantifizierung von Standardisierung und damit verbundenen Kosten. Definieren Sie Kriterien für die Standardisierung und Kriterien für die Neugründung in Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur- und Lieferkettenteams Entwickeln Sie visuelle Dashboards für Engineering Metriken wie Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kapazität, Qualität, Metriken Die Entwicklung von Suchwerkzeugen, die Wiederverwendung bestehender Teile und Komponenten zu verbessern; die Umsetzung in der Designplattform von Features im Zusammenhang mit Standardisierung Erstellen und Aufrechterhaltung einer Spezifikations- und Regeln-Bibliothek basierend auf Kundenprofilen, um die Standardisierung unter den Fabriken zu steuern Geben Sie an, auf welchen Artikeln von PLM (windchill) zur Verbindung mit Design-Tools stehen. Methoden zur Quantifizierung, Messung und Verbesserung der Standardisierungspraktiken. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung geltender externer und interner Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Living Hitachi Energy's Kernwerte von Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Aktionen zu übernehmen, während Pflege für Ihre Kollegen und das Geschäft Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor \ / Master-Abschluss in Engineering ist bevorzugt. Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Ingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Standardisierung. Erprobter Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Standardisierungsstrategien. Starkes Verständnis von Beschaffungsprozessen und Materialmanagement. Erfahrung mit Engineering Dashboards und Metriken. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten, um mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten. Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Strategisches Denken und Planen. Vertraulichkeit mit PLM-Software (PTC Windchill ist bevorzugt) Vorteile bei Normungsprinzipien und -praktiken. Wissen über Value Stream Mapping (VSM) und andere Engineering Metriken. Vertraut mit GMR\/Windchill und anderen Design-Tools. Starke organisatorische und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in gesprochener und geschriebener englischer Sprache sind erforderlich
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Le responsable de la normalisation des GPG sera chargé de définir et de piloter la stratégie de normalisation dans l'ensemble du Groupe mondial des produits (GPG). Le responsable de la normalisation des GPG travaillera en étroite collaboration avec diverses unités opérationnelles, les équipes d'ingénierie et les départements de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour assurer la mise en oeuvre efficace des pratiques de normalisation, qui sont essentielles pour améliorer la disponibilité des matériaux, accélérer les processus d'approvisionnement et tirer parti des économies d'échelle dans un marché en croissance rapide. Comment vous aurez un impact Élaborer et piloter une stratégie de normalisation globale au niveau des GPG, en collaboration avec les unités d'affaires (BU) et les HUB régionaux. Veiller à ce que la stratégie soit conforme aux objectifs organisationnels et aux exigences du marché. Améliorer la normalisation des pièces en quantifiant la normalisation et les coûts connexes. Définir des critères de normalisation et des critères pour la création de nouvelles pièces en collaboration avec les équipes de l'ingénierie et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Élaborer des tableaux de bord visuels pour les mesures d'ingénierie telles que la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM), la capacité, la qualité, les mesures Conduire le développement d'outils de recherche, pour améliorer la réutilisation des pièces et composants existants; Conduire la mise en oeuvre dans la plate-forme de conception de caractéristiques liées à la normalisation Créer et maintenir une bibliothèque de spécifications et de règles basée sur les profils de clients pour conduire la normalisation entre les usines. D'accord sur les éléments de PLM (windchill) à connecter aux outils de conception. Établir des méthodes pour quantifier, mesurer et améliorer les pratiques de normalisation. Responsabilité de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre les valeurs fondamentales de Hitachi Energy en matière de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie avec un accent sur la normalisation. Expérience éprouvée dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de normalisation. Une bonne compréhension des processus d'approvisionnement et de la gestion du matériel. Expérience des tableaux de bord et des mesures techniques. Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration pour travailler avec des équipes interfonctionnelles. Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Pensée stratégique et planification. Familiarité avec le logiciel PLM (PTC Windchill est préféré) Compétence en principes et pratiques de normalisation. Connaissance de la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM) et d'autres paramètres techniques. Familiarité avec GMR\/Windchill et d'autres outils de conception. Fortes compétences en gestion organisationnelle et de projet. Une compétence en anglais parlé et écrit est requise

titleByLocale.it: Global Product Specialista - Dry type transformers (mainstream)

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a Global Product Specialist for mainstream business of Dry-type transformers to join our innovative team in any of these locations: Raleigh\/USA, Bland\/USA, Savli\/India, Vadodara\/India, Cheonan\/South Korea, Zaragoza\/Spain, Shanghai\/China. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the global product manager in managing the dry-type transformer product portfolio, conducting comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the transformer portfolio. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on dry type transformers. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap and technical requirement specifications. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Degree in Electrical\/Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 7 years of experience in R&D, product\/technology development or engineering in dry type transformers, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of dry type transformers, energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product developments. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Fluent English

Come Consigliere Legale, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel nostro team legale fornendo un supporto legale completo a diverse unità aziendali e funzioni centrali. Come generalista si copre tutti i settori del contratto e del diritto commerciale, con un ulteriore focus sulla legge sugli appalti pubblici, R&D, diritto del lavoro e privacy dei dati.

Comment vous allez faire un impact Act en tant qu'analyste principal pour les applications de fabrication , en s'assurant qu'ils répondent aux exigences opérationnelles et stratégiques en évolution Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production, les ingénieurs de processus, les propriétaires d'applications et les intervenants mondiaux de l'IG pour recueillir les exigences , définir des solutions et assurer l'alignement sur tous les sites Analyser et modéliser les processus (p. ex., flux de production, contrôles de qualité, traçabilité, collecte de données), les traduire en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques claires pour les améliorations du système ou les nouvelles capacités de fabrication Soutenir le cycle de vie complet des applications de fabrication, assurer la sécurité, la conformité, la fiabilité et l'intégration aux systèmes critiques Faciliter les ateliers, effectuer des analyses d'écarts, diriger les réunions des intervenants et créer une documentation claire pour assurer une compréhension partagée et une prise de décision efficace Identifier les possibilités de rationaliser les paysages du système, améliorer la qualité des données, réduire le travail manuel et renforcer l'harmonisation entre les usines Favoriser l'amélioration continue par la surveillance du rendement du système, recueillir les commentaires des utilisateurs et proposer des améliorations pour ne pas accroître la valeur et l'efficacité Votre expérience acquise en tant en tant
• Nous offrons un package d'avantages concurrentiel suisse conçu pour soutenir votre croissance professionnelle et votre bien-être.
