descriptionByLocale.it: Job Description The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient industrial specialist with expertise in power system analysis\/ management and high-level programming. In an inter-disciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic and motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. How you'll make an impact You create impact: Together with your team design innovative approaches for grid operation and deliver them as robust software modules You investigate: Translate real power‑system problems into rigorous models and final solutions for the customers You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and inter-disciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy to drive the development from concept to production You connect: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, start-ups, and vendors to integrate diverse perspectives and stakeholder inputs You communicate: Be able to clearly communicate concepts to software developers, implementation engineering teams and customers. Produce clear design docs and developer-facing examples\/ notebooks that enable reuse. Your background Master Electrical\/Power Systems Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience Proven expertise in modelling and steady-state analyses of power grids demonstrated hands-on expertise applying these methods in software development. Knowledge in mathematical optimization applied to power systems, and modern numerical solvers is strongly desired (e.g., MIP\/NLP, stochastic; tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Ipopt). Experience with machine learning and\/or artificial intelligence technologies is a plus Proficiency in C#, C++, Rust or a similar high-level programming language is required; Python and\/or Matlab for analytics and fast prototyping are a plus. Experience building state-of-the-art software engineering techniques (version control, code reviews, testing, CI\/CD) and integrating solution algorithms into applications are beneficial (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). High performance computing skills such as parallel\/distributed computing, GPU, OpenMP or MPI would be beneficial Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out. We can provide more information during the recruitment process. Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? In an inter-disciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic and motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. descriptionByLocale.it: Join Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business as our Global Head of Sales. You will lead a global team driving commercial strategy and sales execution across a portfolio that includes enterprise software, automation and communications, power conversion solutions and services. This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of our global go-to-market transformation (Suisen)—focused on customer connection, agility, empowerment, and commercial excellence. You will work across product lines and regions to align diverse sales teams and deliver growth, while shaping how we serve customers in a rapidly evolving energy landscape. The location of this role is flexible globally and will be determined in subsequent stages. How You'll Make an Impact Lead global sales performance across all Grid Automation offerings. Manage a small central team of industry leaders and functional experts focused on global sales strategy and governance. Provide dotted-line leadership to sales leaders in global product groups and regional hubs. Align multiple sales operating models under a unified go-to-market strategy. Drive forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and deal governance. Champion customer-first sales execution and strategic account leadership. Accelerate growth in software, digital, and lifecycle-based offerings. Expand reach through partner ecosystems and channel programs. Collaborate with regional, product, and functional leaders to ensure execution. Lead through transformation, simplifying structures and empowering teams. Your Background 15+ years in global sales leadership roles in energy, software, or industrial sectors. Proven success managing complex, matrixed sales organizations. Experience leading sales transformation or go-to-market redesigns. Strong commercial acumen and forecasting discipline. Familiarity with enterprise software, automation, and power systems. Executive presence and ability to influence across functions and geographies. Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred. Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Sei un Project Manager esperto nel settore industriale o all'interno di progetti di applicazione ferroviaria? Combina forti competenze organizzative con la capacità di fornire soluzioni commerciali e tecniche di alta qualità per i clienti? Allora potrebbe essere l'opportunita' giusta per te. Siamo alla ricerca di un Project Development and Change Manager che sovrintenderà a progetti ferroviari di varie dimensioni e complessità e supporterà l'organizzazione nel fornire i prodotti e le soluzioni di servizio giusti ai nostri clienti. Gestione dei progetti e delle opportunità identificate dal kick-off del progetto, supervisiona l'esecuzione del progetto in linea con le migliori pratiche, le politiche di HE e le linee guida, mentre controlla il progresso e l'utilizzo delle risorse. Rappresenta la voce del cliente internamente, agendo come chiave di contatto del cliente e punto di escalation, e la costruzione di forti relazioni di stakeholder basate sulla fiducia Fornisce informazioni periodiche di progetto al FaMO Capacità di motivare e potenziare i membri del team Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di trasmettere chiaramente informazioni, allineare gli stakeholder e gestire le aspettative Fluency in francese, livello B2 in inglese; il tedesco è un plus Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Are you an experienced Project Manager in the industrial sector or within railway application projects? Do you combine strong organizational skills with the ability to deliver high‑quality commercial and technical solutions for customers? Then this could be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for a Project Development and Change Manager who will oversee railway projects of varying size and complexity and support the organization in delivering the right products and service solutions to our customers. How you'll make an impact Drives adherence to contractual milestones by continuously monitoring project progress, including identified risks and opportunities from project kick-off onward Oversees project execution in line with best practices, HE policies, and guidelines, while controlling progress and resource utilization Represents the customer voice internally, acting as key customer contact and escalation point, and building strong, trust-based stakeholder relationships Provides regular and structured project reporting to the PMO through periodic review meetings Facilitates effective and timely communication with internal project stakeholders and supports information flow as required Applies HE Tier accountability principles to escalate critical deviations or customer claims and supports corrective actions and escalations Manages customer change requests by collecting, documenting, and coordinating variation offers with stakeholders, and following through until order, delivery, and invoicing Monitors project financials in close collaboration with the project controller, maintains documentation accuracy, and drives the capture and sharing of lessons learned Your background Bachelor or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field 2–3 years of experience as a Project Manager in railway or industrial application projects PMP certification is an advantage Very good knowledge of MS Office tools (Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Ability to motivate and empower team members Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey information, align stakeholders, and manage expectations Fluency in French, B2 level in English; German is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Sind Sie ein erfahrener Projektmanager im Industriebereich oder in Bahnprojekten? Kombinieren Sie starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, qualitativ hochwertige kommerzielle und technische Lösungen für Kunden zu liefern? Dann könnte das die richtige Gelegenheit für Sie sein. Wir suchen einen Project Development and Change Manager, der Bahnprojekte unterschiedlicher Größe und Komplexität betreut und die Organisation bei der Bereitstellung der richtigen Produkte und Servicelösungen für unsere Kunden unterstützt. Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen Drives Einhaltung von vertraglichen Meilensteinen durch kontinuierliche Überwachung Projektfortschritt, einschließlich identifizierte Risiken und Chancen von Projekt-Kick-off-On-Übersichten Projekt-Ausführung in Übereinstimmung mit Best Practices, HE-Richtlinien und Richtlinien, während Controlling Fortschritt und Ressourcenauslastung Repräsentiert die Kunden-Stimmung intern, als Schlüssel Kundenkontakt und Eskalation Punkt, und Aufbau von starken, vertrauensbasierten Stakeholder-Beziehungen Fähigkeit, Teammitglieder zu motivieren und zu stärken Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Informationen klar zu vermitteln, Stakeholder auszurichten und Erwartungen zu verwalten Fluency in Französisch, B2 Ebene in Englisch; Deutsch ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren, während Sie eine Umgebung schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté dans le secteur industriel ou dans le cadre de projets d'application ferroviaire? Combinez-vous de solides compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de fournir des solutions commerciales et techniques de haute qualité aux clients? Alors ce pourrait être la bonne occasion pour vous. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de projets et de changements qui supervisera des projets ferroviaires de taille et de complexité variables et qui aidera l'organisation à fournir les bons produits et solutions de service à nos clients. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Conduire le respect des étapes contractuelles en surveillant en permanence les progrès du projet, y compris les risques et les possibilités découlant du lancement du projet. Superviser l'exécution du projet conformément aux pratiques exemplaires, aux politiques et aux lignes directrices de l'AE, tout en contrôlant les progrès et l'utilisation des ressources. Représenter la voix des clients à l'interne, agir comme point de contact et d'escalade des clients, et établir des relations solides et fondées sur la confiance. Capacité de motiver et de responsabiliser les membres de l'équipe Fortes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de transmettre clairement l'information, d'aligner les intervenants et de gérer les attentes Fluence en français, niveau B2 en anglais; l'allemand est un atout Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
• Stiamo cercando un leader di qualità esperto per guidare l'agenda di Qualità e miglioramento continuo (CI) in tutto il nostro Hub Europe. In questo ruolo chiave di leadership, si possiede la strategia di qualità, rafforzare i nostri sistemi di gestione della qualità, garantire la soddisfazione del cliente, e lead certificazione, audit e iniziative di miglioramento continuo in tutte le entità del Hub. Dove CI è in ambito, si distribuirà anche una cultura CI sostenibile e una struttura di miglioramento. La posizione di questo ruolo è flessibile in Europa e sarà determinata nelle fasi successive. Come farete un impatto Qualità & Leadership CI Definire e implementare la strategia Hub Quality e CI. Assicurare l'allineamento con le direttive globali, i requisiti normativi e le esigenze aziendali. Guidare la costruzione e la governance attraverso i team Hub Quality e CI. Customer Focus Incorpora la Voce del Cliente in tutte le iniziative di Qualità. Rappresentare l'azienda nelle discussioni dei clienti su questioni di qualità. Valutare i rischi e implementare soluzioni per garantire un'elevata soddisfazione del cliente. Sistema di Gestione della Qualità & Certificazione Condurre lo sviluppo e la manutenzione del Sistema di Gestione della Qualità. Controllare gli audit interni/esterni e garantire la chiusura tempestiva delle azioni. Certificazioni richieste sicure in tutte le unità Hub. Performance & Miglioramento Monitor processo e offrire prestazioni; analizzare le tendenze e guidare azioni correttive. Identificare opportunità di miglioramento e collaborare con gli stakeholder per implementare i cambiamenti. Escalare i problemi di qualità dei fornitori e garantire la risoluzione. Gestione non conformità Gestisci NCR di alto profilo e interventi dei clienti. Assicurare un contenimento efficace, misure correttive e preventive per proteggere la fiducia dei clienti. Rilevamento continuo del quadro di miglioramento continuo (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, ecc.). Supporto e priorità progetti di miglioramento che elevano qualità e prestazioni operative. Il tuo corso di laurea in un campo correlato; un master o MBA è un vantaggio. 10-15 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile in un ambiente multinazionale. Una forte esperienza di leadership nella gestione della qualità; la leadership CI è un vantaggio. Capacità di analizzare le prestazioni, risolvere i problemi sistematicamente e gestire i rischi. Solida influenza, comunicazione, gestione dei cambiamenti e capacità di risoluzione dei conflitti. mentalità orientata al cliente e comprovata capacità di collaborare attraverso le funzioni.
descriptionByLocale.en: The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Quality leader to drive the Quality and Continuous Improvement (CI) agenda across our Hub Europe. In this key leadership role, you will own the Quality strategy, strengthen our Quality Management Systems, ensure customer satisfaction, and lead certification, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives across all entities in the Hub. Where CI is in scope, you will also deploy a sustainable CI culture and improvement structure. The location of this role is flexible within Europe, and will be determined in later stages. How you will make an impact Quality & CI Leadership Define and implement the Hub Quality and CI strategy. Ensure alignment with global directives, regulatory requirements, and business needs. Drive capability building and governance across Hub Quality and CI teams. Customer Focus Embed the Voice of the Customer in all Quality initiatives. Represent the company in customer discussions on quality matters. Evaluate risks and implement solutions to secure high customer satisfaction. Quality Management System & Certification Lead the development and maintenance of the Quality Management System. Oversee internal\/external audits and ensure timely closure of actions. Secure required certifications across all Hub units. Performance & Improvement Monitor process and offer performance; analyze trends and drive corrective actions. Identify improvement opportunities and collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes. Escalate supplier quality issues and ensure resolution. Non‑Conformance Management Manage high‑profile NCRs and customer interventions. Ensure effective containment, corrective, and preventive measures to protect customer trust. Continuous Improvement Deploy the Continuous Improvement Framework (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, etc.). Support and prioritize improvement projects that elevate quality and operational performance. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in a similar role within a multinational environment. Strong leadership experience in Quality Management; CI leadership is a plus. Ability to analyse performance, solve problems systematically, and manage risks. Solid influencing, communication, change management, and conflict‑resolution skills. Customer‑centric mindset and proven ability to collaborate across functions.
descriptionByLocale.de:

In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle besitzen Sie die Qualitätsstrategie, stärken unsere Qualitätsmanagementsysteme, sorgen für Kundenzufriedenheit und führen Zertifizierung, Audits und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Unternehmen des Hubs. Wenn CI in Reichweite ist, werden Sie auch eine nachhaltige CI-Kultur und Verbesserung Struktur einsetzen. Der Standort dieser Rolle ist in Europa flexibel und wird später bestimmt. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf Qualität & CI Leadership Definieren und implementieren die Hub Quality and CI Strategie. Gewährleistung der Angleichung an globale Richtlinien, regulatorische
• Anforderungen und Geschäftsanforderungen. Antriebsfähigkeitsaufbau und Governance in Hub Quality und CI-Teams. Customer Focus Embed the Voice of the Customer in allen Qualitätsinitiativen. Vertreten Sie das Unternehmen in Kundengesprächen zu Qualitätsfragen. Risiken auswerten und Lösungen implementieren, um eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten. Qualitätsmanagement System & Zertifizierung Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Wartung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems. Sehen Sie interne / externe Audits und sorgen Sie für eine rechtzeitige Schließung von Aktionen. Sichere Zertifizierungen über alle Hub-Einheiten. Performance & Verbesserung Monitor Prozess und bieten Leistung; analysieren Trends und treiben Korrekturmaßnahmen. Identifizieren Sie Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und arbeiten Sie mit den Interessengruppen zusammen, um Änderungen vorzunehmen. Eskalieren Sie die Fragen der Lieferantenqualität und stellen Sie die Lösung sicher. Non‐Conformance Management Verwalten Sie hochkarätige NCRs und Kundeninterventionen. Gewährleistung wirksamer Eindämmung, Korrektur und vorbeugende Maßnahmen zum Schutz des Kundenvertrauens. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung des kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsrahmens (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, etc.). Unterstützung und Priorisierung von Verbesserungsprojekten, die Qualität und operative Leistung erhöhen. Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich; ein Master-Abschluss oder MBA ist ein Vorteil. 10–15 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem multinationalen Umfeld. Starke Führungserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement; CI-Führung ist ein Plus. Fähigkeit, Leistung zu analysieren, Probleme systematisch zu lösen und Risiken zu bewältigen. Solide Einflussnahme, Kommunikation, Change Management und Konfliktlösungsfähigkeiten. Customer‐centric mindset und bewährte Fähigkeit, über Funktionen zusammenzuarbeiten.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader expérimenté de la qualité pour piloter le programme Qualité et amélioration continue (IC) dans notre Hub Europe. Dans ce rôle clé de leadership, vous posséderez la stratégie Qualité, renforcerez nos systèmes de gestion de la qualité, assurerez la satisfaction des clients et dirigerez des initiatives de certification, d'audit et d'amélioration continue dans toutes les entités du Hub. Lorsque l'IC a une portée, vous allez également déployer une culture et une structure d'amélioration durables de l'IC. L'emplacement de ce rôle est souple en Europe et sera déterminé ultérieurement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Qualité et leadership de l'IC Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie Hub Qualité et IC. Assurer l'alignement sur les directives mondiales, les exigences réglementaires et les besoins des entreprises. Favoriser le renforcement des capacités et la gouvernance au sein des équipes de la qualité du Hub et de l'IC. Focus client Intégrez la voix du client dans toutes les initiatives Qualité. Représenter l'entreprise dans les discussions des clients sur les questions de qualité. Évaluer les risques et mettre en œuvre des solutions pour garantir une satisfaction élevée de la clientèle. Système de gestion de la qualité et certification Diriger le développement et la maintenance du système de gestion de la qualité. Superviser les vérifications internes/externes et assurer la clôture en temps opportun des actions. Sécuriser les certifications requises dans toutes les unités du Hub. Rendement et amélioration Surveiller le processus et offrir le rendement; analyser les tendances et prendre des mesures correctives. Identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et collaborer avec les intervenants pour mettre en oeuvre les changements. Évaluer les problèmes de qualité des fournisseurs et assurer la résolution. Gestion de la non-conformité Gérer les RCN et les interventions des clients. Assurer un confinement efficace, des mesures correctives et préventives pour protéger la confiance des clients. Amélioration continue Déployer le cadre d'amélioration continue (Lighthouse, L6S, leçons apprises, etc.). Appuyer et prioriser les projets d'amélioration qui améliorent la qualité et le rendement opérationnel. Votre licence d'études dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un MBA est un avantage. 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire au sein d'un environnement multinational. Une solide expérience de leadership en gestion de la qualité; le leadership de l'IC est un atout. Capacité d'analyser les performances, de résoudre les problèmes systématiquement et de gérer les risques. Des compétences solides en matière d'influence, de communication, de gestion du changement et de résolution des conflits. L'état d'esprit du client et la capacité éprouvée de collaborer entre les fonctions.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Nel tuo ruolo di Specialista di Servizio IT in loco, sarai responsabile della consegna del Supporto Side Desk agli utenti IT, in particolare della gestione dei problemi IT che richiedono un intervento fisico. I vostri doveri si estenderanno per aiutare la risoluzione degli incidenti attraverso la collaborazione con vari team di supporto e gruppi all'interno del reparto IT. Si svolgerà un ruolo critico, servendo come rappresentante dell'organizzazione IT, agendo come l'interfaccia tra il cliente e altre funzioni IT. Come farete un impatto Diagnosi e risolve i problemi legati all'IT in modo efficace ed efficiente Assicura che i computer sono forniti in una condizione 'ready-to-use' per gli utenti IT Fornisce una formazione ad-hoc per gli utenti su questioni IT comuni e li guida attraverso strumenti di auto-servizio Maniglie casi di garanzia in collaborazione con i fornitori di attrezzature originali appropriate (OEM) Identificare e segnalare potenziali rischi che potrebbero influenzare la qualità dei servizi di fine OSS Demonstra una capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed è auto-driven L'autorizzazione legale per lavorare in posizione applicata è necessaria. Hitachi Energy si impegna a creare un ambiente di lavoro diversificato, inclusivo e collaborativo in cui le persone provenienti da diversi contesti si uniscono per costruire soluzioni innovative per un futuro energetico più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity In your role as an On-site IT Service Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering Desk Side Support to IT users, specifically handling IT issues that require physical intervention. Your duties will extend to aiding incident resolution through collaboration with various support teams and groups within the IT department. You will play a critical role, serving as a representative of the IT organization, acting as the interface between the customer and other IT functions. How you'll make an impact Diagnoses and resolves IT-related issues effectively and efficiently Ensures that computers are delivered in a 'ready-to-use' condition for IT users Provides ad-hoc training to users on common IT issues and guides them through self-service tools Handles warranty cases in collaboration with the appropriate Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) vendors Identifies and report potential risks that could impact the quality of OSS services Offers support to end users and ensure the functionality of IT equipment and software in meeting rooms and other user collaboration areas as part of desk-side support Adheres to prescribed OSS governance, which involves participating in meetings and following the escalation process, among other responsibilities Follows OSS procedures as outlined in the Runbook, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and knowledge articles Your background Formal qualification in IT completed from an accredited university or college OR completed an apprenticeship in the field of IT ​ Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences in German and English. ​ Proactive and solution-oriented mindset ​ Demonstrates an ability to work independently and is self-driven ​ Legal authorization to work in applied location is required . We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this role ​ More about us Hitachi Energy is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment where people from different backgrounds come together to build innovative solutions for a more sustainable energy future.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans votre rôle de spécialiste des services informatiques sur place, vous serez chargé de fournir un soutien côté bureau aux utilisateurs de TI, en particulier pour traiter les problèmes informatiques qui nécessitent une intervention physique. Vos fonctions s'étendront à la résolution d'incidents grâce à la collaboration avec diverses équipes et groupes de soutien au sein du service informatique. Vous jouerez un rôle crucial en tant que représentant de l'organisation informatique, agissant comme interface entre le client et les autres fonctions informatiques. Comment vous ferez un impact Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la TI de façon efficace et efficiente Veiller à ce que les ordinateurs soient livrés dans un état « prêt à l'emploi » pour les utilisateurs de la TI Offrir une formation ad hoc aux utilisateurs sur les problèmes communs de TI et les guider à l'aide d'outils en libre-service Gérer les cas de garantie en collaboration avec les fournisseurs d'équipement d'origine appropriés Identifier et signaler les risques potentiels qui pourraient avoir une incidence sur la qualité des services SSO Offrir un soutien aux utilisateurs finals et assurer la fonctionnalité de l'équipement et des logiciels de TI dans les salles de réunion et d'autres domaines de collaboration des utilisateurs dans le cadre du soutien côté bureau Adhérer à la gouvernance de SSO prescrite, qui consiste à participer aux réunions et à suivre le processus d'escalade, entre autres responsabilités Suivre les procédures SSO décrites dans le Runbook, les procédures d'exploitation normalisées (SOP) et les articles sur les connaissances Votre expérience Qualification officielle en TI obtenue d'une université ou d'un collège accrédité OU complété un apprentissage dans le domaine de la TI Excellentes compétences en communication, tant écrites que verbales, y compris la capacité de communiquer efficacement Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la solution démontre une capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et est autonome. Nous ne parrainerons pas de personnes pour des visas d'emploi maintenant ou à l'avenir pour ce rôle Plus sur nous Hitachi Energy s'engage à créer un environnement de travail diversifié, inclusif et collaboratif où des personnes de différents horizons se réunissent pour construire des solutions innovantes pour un avenir énergétique plus durable.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken English Team player and well organized Creative and able to work autonomously Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity The role involves leading & ensuring the execution of the backlog according to priorities. Candidate will drive design platform process improvements, maintain burnup dashboards, and track agreed programming KPIs. This role requires strong leadership, coordination with R&D, and support for users on technical questions. How you'll make an impact Ensure backlog execution according to priorities. Drive continuous improvements in the design platform process. Maintain burnup dashboards and monitor programming KPIs. Provide effort estimations during the prioritization process. Coordinate with R&D to ensure clear understanding of Technical Specifications (TS). Address users' tickets and escalate issues when necessary. Support users on technical questions and provide guidance. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background ​ 7+years of experience with Masters or Bachelor of Engineering in mechanical design, Information technology. Proven experience in mechanical design and development. Strong understanding of technical specification development and R&D workflows. Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage priorities and drive timely execution. Experience in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements and maintain KPIs

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si riferirà al Direttore del Dipartimento di Project Management e sostenere un team globale in crescita di oltre 70 Project Manager a livello globale. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rafforzare l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione del progetto per i nostri progetti clienti Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) plasmando processi robusti, governance e iniziative di miglioramento continuo in un portafoglio di progetti diversificato. Questa posizione offre un'opportunità unica per combinare la proprietà strategica del processo, la governance del portafoglio e la leadership di miglioramento continuo in un ambiente di progetto internazionale. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Sviluppare, implementare e migliorare continuamente i processi di gestione dei progetti, gli standard e la governance in un portafoglio di progetti globale - Rafforzare la competenza del processo e del portafoglio per garantire trasparenza e consegna on-time (OTD) dei progetti dei clienti - Tradurre lezioni apprese dall'esecuzione del progetto in azioni di miglioramento continuo strutturato (CI) - Guidare e sostenere iniziative strategiche di gestione del progetto a medio termine in stretta collaborazione interfunzionale - Agire come punto di escalation per le questioni di gestione dei progetti sistemici e guidare risoluzioni sostenibili - Assicurare i metodi di gestione del progetto, gli strumenti e i sistemi IT sono adatti a scopo e continuamente ottimizzati - Leva l'analisi dei dati per supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati e identificare le opportunità di miglioramento - Contribuire attivamente e collaborare all'interno della comunità CI, promuovendo una cultura di apprendimento e miglioramento Il tuo sfondo - 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti in ambienti di progetto complessi e internazionali - Forte competenza nei processi di gestione del progetto, governance e gestione del portafoglio - certificazione Project Management Professional (PMP) - Cintura verde Lean Six Sigma o Cintura nera con un forte miglioramento continuo - Esperienza nell'analisi aziendale e applicazione dei concetti Lean in un ambiente basato sulla tecnologia - Prove capacità di leadership, gestione degli stakeholder e comunicazione - Gestione di partner esterni e risorse contrattuali - Membro attivo di una comunità CI, con una mentalità collaborativa e condivisione delle conoscenze Ulteriori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## The opportunity In this role, you will report to the Department Manager of Project Management and support a growing global team of more than 70 Project Managers globally. You will play a key role in strengthening project execution excellence for our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) customer projects by shaping robust processes, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives across a diverse project portfolio. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine strategic process ownership, portfolio governance, and continuous improvement leadership in an international project environment. ## How you'll make an impact - Develop, implement, and continuously improve project management processes, standards, and governance across a global project portfolio - Strengthen process and portfolio competence to ensure transparency and on‑time delivery (OTD) of customer projects - Translate lessons learned from project execution into structured continuous improvement (CI) actions - Lead and support mid‑term strategic project management initiatives in close cross‑functional collaboration - Act as an escalation point for systemic project management issues and drive sustainable resolutions - Ensure project management methods, tools, and IT systems are fit for purpose and continuously optimized - Leverage data analytics to support data‑driven decision‑making and identify improvement opportunities - Actively contribute to and collaborate within the CI community, fostering a learning and improvement culture ## Your background - 5+ years of experience in project management within complex, international project environments - Strong expertise in project management processes, governance, and portfolio management - Project Management Professional (PMP) certification - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt with a strong continuous improvement mindset - Experience in business analysis and applying Lean concepts in a technology-driven environment - Proven leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills - Experience managing external partners and contract resources - Active member of a CI community, with a collaborative and knowledge-sharing mindset ## More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit In dieser Funktion melden Sie sich an den Abteilungsleiter des Projektmanagements und unterstützen ein wachsendes globales Team von über 70 Projektmanagern weltweit. Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle bei der Stärkung der Projektdurchführung für unsere Kundenprojekte Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) spielen, indem Sie robuste Prozesse, Governance und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in einem vielfältigen Projektportfolio ausarbeiten. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, strategische Prozessbesitz, Portfolio Governance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Führung in einem internationalen Projektumfeld zu kombinieren. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Entwicklung, Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Projektmanagementprozesse, Standards und Governance in einem globalen Projektportfolio - Prozess- und Portfoliokompetenz stärken, um Transparenz und pünktliche Lieferung (OTD) von Kundenprojekten zu gewährleisten - Übersetzen lernen von der Projektdurchführung in strukturierte kontinuierliche Verbesserung (CI) Aktionen - Leiten und unterstützen mittelfristige strategische Projektmanagementinitiativen in enger funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit - Akt als Eskalationspunkt für systemische Projektmanagement-Themen und treiben nachhaltige Entschließungen - Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projektmanagementmethoden, Werkzeuge und IT-Systeme zielgerecht und kontinuierlich optimiert sind - Datenanalyse zur Unterstützung datengesteuerter Entscheidungsfindung und zur Identifizierung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten - Aktiver Beitrag und Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der CI-Gemeinschaft, Förderung einer Lern- und Verbesserungskultur Ihr Hintergrund - 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement in komplexen, internationalen Projektumgebungen - Starkes Know-how im Projektmanagement, Governance und Portfoliomanagement - Projektmanagement Professional (PMP) Zertifizierung - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt oder Black Belt mit einer starken kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Mindset - Erfahrung in der Unternehmensanalyse und Anwendung von Lean-Konzepten in einer technologiegetriebenen Umgebung - Bewährte Führung, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Erfahrungsmanagement von externen Partnern und Vertragsressourcen - Aktives Mitglied einer CI-Gemeinschaft, mit einem kollaborativen und wissensteilenden Geistset Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous ferez rapport au gestionnaire de projet du Ministère et soutiendraz une équipe mondiale croissante de plus de 70 gestionnaires de projet à l'échelle mondiale. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le renforcement de l'excellence d'exécution des projets pour nos projets clients de commutateurs isolés au gaz (SIG) en formant des processus robustes, des initiatives de gouvernance et d'amélioration continue dans un portefeuille de projets diversifié. Ce poste offre une occasion unique de combiner l'appropriation stratégique des processus, la gouvernance du portefeuille et le leadership d'amélioration continue dans un environnement de projet international. Comment vous ferez un impact - Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et améliorer continuellement les processus de gestion de projet, les normes et la gouvernance dans un portefeuille de projets mondial - Renforcer les compétences en matière de processus et de portefeuille pour assurer la transparence et la livraison à temps des projets clients - Traduire les enseignements tirés de l'exécution de projets en actions d'amélioration continue structurée (IC) - Diriger et appuyer des initiatives de gestion de projet stratégique à moyen terme en étroite collaboration interfonctionnelle - Agir comme un point d'escalade pour les questions systémiques de gestion de projets et favoriser des résolutions durables - S'assurer que les méthodes de gestion de projet, les outils et les systèmes informatiques sont adaptés à l'objectif et optimisés en permanence - Tirer parti de l'analyse des données pour appuyer la prise de décision axée sur les données et identifier les possibilités d'amélioration - Contribuer activement et collaborer au sein de la communauté des IC, en favorisant une culture d'apprentissage et d'amélioration Vos antécédents - 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projets dans des environnements de projets complexes et internationaux - Forte expertise en gestion de projets, gouvernance et gestion de portefeuille - Certification professionnelle de gestion de projet (PMP) - Lean Six Sigma ceinture verte ou ceinture noire avec une forte amélioration continue de l'état d'esprit - Expérience dans l'analyse des affaires et l'application des concepts Lean dans un environnement technologique - Compétences éprouvées en leadership, en gestion des intervenants et en communication - Expérience de la gestion des partenaires externes et des ressources contractuelles - Membre actif d'une communauté d'IC, avec un esprit de collaboration et de partage des connaissances Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione - Fa parte di un team dedicato e si assume la responsabilità di creare e gestire un parco macchine versatile ed esigente - Per operazioni fluide nella produzione, si controlla autonomamente gli ordini, effettua controlli di qualità e assicura la disponibilità operativa delle macchine - Con know-how tecnico, iniziativa e spirito di squadra Sei attivo nell'efficienza e nello sviluppo dei nostri processi produttivi - La nostra fabbrica di Klingnau è a disposizione dei nostri clienti come centro di competenza per la lavorazione di materie plastiche ad alta precisione a livello mondiale - La posizione vive da un team flessibile e motivato con una gerarchia piana e brevi percorsi decisionali - Attraverso la continua espansione delle nostre competenze nel campo della lavorazione delle materie plastiche e il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi aziendali, offriamo ai nostri clienti soluzioni innovative, affidabili, individuali e sicure per le vostre preoccupazioni nei segmenti generazione/distribuzione di potenza, ferrovia, spazio, servizio e industria - Vi forniremo questo a prezzi ragionevoli, nel tempo nella qualità desiderata - Garantiamo la nostra competitività automatizzando e ottimizzando le nostre linee di produzione per poter rispondere in modo ancora più rapido e flessibile ai requisiti globali del mercato e del cliente - Puoi farlo. Mansioni - Funzionamento della macchina: Regolazione e funzionamento di un complesso parco macchine convenzionale (comprese le fresatrici multi-mandrino, le rettificatrici del cilindro, le seghe multi-mandrino, le fresatrici e le macchine di raffreddamento) - Apparecchiature di prova e vuoti: installazione indipendente e funzionamento di apparecchiature di prova elettriche e vari sistemi di rifilatura - Controllo degli ordini: coordinare e controllare gli ordini di produzione in modo indipendente e garantire un'elaborazione tempestiva - Controllo qualità: si effettuano controlli di qualità regolari sui componenti lavorati – da singole parti a piccole serie - Manutenzione e manutenzione: si assume la manutenzione e la manutenzione delle macchine utilizzate e si assicura la loro disponibilità operativa affidabile - Monitoraggio degli strumenti: Tenere d'occhio l'uso degli aiuti di fabbricazione e garantire la loro disponibilità e funzionalità - Trasporti & Logistica: Si servono diversi camion industriali e quindi supporta un flusso liscio di materiali in produzione
• Requisiti - Formazione completa come meccanico polimeccanico, industriale, costruttore di stampi, carpentiere o in una professione simile con esperienza pluriennale in una posizione comparabile - Buona conoscenza tedesca della parola e della scrittura, conoscenza inglese del vantaggio - Siete pronti per il team, lavorate in modo indipendente e portate un elevato senso di responsabilità - Hai un'ottima comprensione dei disegni e delle liste tecniche - Sei flessibile, mostra la tua iniziativa e porta ad alte prestazioni - Il pensiero imprenditoriale e l'orientamento del cliente pronunciato ti caratterizzano Cosa? - I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere le loro competenze
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione - Be part of a dedicated team and take responsibility to set up and operate a versatile and demanding machine park - For smooth operations in production, you control orders autonomously, perform quality checks and ensure the operational readiness of the machines - With technical know-how, initiative and team spirit You are active in the efficiency and further development of our production processes - Our factory in Klingnau is available to our customers as a center of expertise for high-precision plastics processing at world level - The location lives by a flexible and motivated team with a flat hierarchy and short decision-making paths - Through the continuous expansion of our competencies in the field of plastics processing as well as the continuous improvement of our business processes, we offer our customers innovative, reliable, individual and safe solutions for your concerns in the segments power generation/distribution, railway, space, service and industry - We will provide you with this at reasonable prices, on time in the desired quality - We ensure our competitiveness by automating and optimizing our production lines in order to be able to respond even more quickly and flexibly to global market and customer requirements - You can do that Mansioni - Machine operation: Self-adjustment and operation of a complex conventional machine park (including multi-spindle-portal milling machines, cylinder grinding machines, multi-spindle saws, milling machines and cooling machines) - Test equipment & blanks: independent installation and operation of electrical test equipment and various trimming systems - Control of orders: You coordinate and control production orders independently and ensure a timely processing - Quality check: You carry out regular quality checks on processed components – from individual parts to small series - Maintenance and maintenance: You take over the maintenance and maintenance of the machines used and ensure their reliable operational readiness - Monitoring of tools: You keep an eye on the use of manufacturing aids and ensure their availability and functionality - Transport & Logistics: You serve different industrial trucks and thus supports a smooth flow of materials in production
• Requisiti - Complete training as a polymechanic, industrial mechanic, mould builder, carpenter or in a similar profession with multi-year experience in a comparable position - Good German knowledge of word and writing, English knowledge of advantage - You are team-ready, work independently and bring a high degree of sense of responsibility - You have an excellent understanding of technical drawings and lists - You are flexible, show your own initiative and bring a high performance - Entrepreneurial thinking and a pronounced customer orientation characterize you
• Cosa offriamo - Our flexible working methods help you to optimize your professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow their skills

## Descrizione - Werde Teil eines engagierten Teams und übernimm Verantwortung beim Einrichten und Bedienen eines vielseitigen und anspruchsvollen Maschinenparks - Du sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe in der Fertigung, steuerst Aufträge eigenständig, führst Qualitätsprüfungen durch und stellst die Einsatzbereitschaft der Maschinen sicher - Mit technischem Know-how, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist trägst Du aktiv zur Effizienz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsprozesse bei - Unsere Fabrik in Klingnau steht unseren Kunden als Kompetenzzentrum für die hochpräzise Kunststoffverarbeitung auf Weltniveau zur Verfügung - Der Standort lebt von einem flexiblen und motivierten Team mit einer flachen Hierarchie und kurzen Entscheidungswegen - Durch den stetigen Ausbau unserer Kompetenzen im Bereich der Kunststoffverarbeitung als auch durch die ständige Verbesserung unserer Geschäftsprozesse offerieren wir unseren Kunden innovative, zuverlässige, individuelle und sichere Lösungen für Ihre Anliegen in den Segmenten Stromerzeugung/-verteilung, Railway, Raumfahrt, Service und Industrie - Diesen stellen wir Ihnen zu angemessenen Preisen, termingerecht in der gewünschten Qualität zur Verfügung - Wir sichern unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit durch Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Fertigungslinien, um damit noch schneller und flexibler auf weltweite Markt und Kundenanforderungen eingehen zu können - Das kannst Du bewirken ## Mansioni - Maschinenbedienung: Selbstständiges Einrichten und Bedienen eines komplexen konventionellen Maschinenparks (u. a. Mehrspindelportalfräsmaschinen, Zylinderschleifmaschinen, Mehrblattsägen, Fräs- sowie Kehlmaschinen) - Prüfanlagen & Zuschnitt: Eigenständiges Einrichten und Bedienen elektrischer Prüfanlagen sowie verschiedener Besäumanlagen - Steuerung von Aufträgen: Du koordinierst und steuerst Fertigungsaufträge eigenverantwortlich und stellst eine termingerechte Abarbeitung sicher - Qualitätsprüfung: Du führst regelmäßige Qualitätsprüfungen an bearbeiteten Bauteilen durch – von Einzelteilen bis hin zu Kleinserien - Wartung und Instandhaltung: Du übernimmst die Wartung und den Unterhalt der eingesetzten Maschinen und sorgst für deren zuverlässige Einsatzbereitschaft - Überwachung von Hilfsmitteln: Du behältst den Einsatz von Fertigungshilfsmitteln im Blick und stellst deren Verfügbarkeit und Funktionalität sicher - Transport & Logistik: Du bedienst verschiedene Flurförderfahrzeuge und unterstützt so einen reibungslosen Materialfluss in der Produktion ##
• Requisiti - Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Polymechaniker, Industriemechaniker, Formenbauer, Schreiner oder in einem ähnlichen Beruf mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position - Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil - Du bist teamfähig, arbeitest selbstständig und bringst ein hohes Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit - Du besitzt ein ausgezeichnetes Verständnis für technische Zeichnungen und Stücklisten - Du bist flexibel, zeigst Eigeninitiative und bringst eine hohe Leistungsbereitschaft mit - Unternehmerisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung zeichnen dich aus ##

Descrizione - Faites partie d'une équipe dévouée et prenez la responsabilité de mettre en place et d'exploiter un parc de machines polyvalent et exigeant - Pour des opérations en douceur dans la production, vous contrôlez les commandes de manière autonome, effectuez des contrôles de qualité et assurez la disponibilité opérationnelle des machines - Avec savoir-faire technique, initiative et esprit d'équipe Vous êtes actif dans l'efficacité et le développement de nos processus de production - Notre usine de Klingnau est à la disposition de nos clients en tant que centre d'expertise pour le traitement des plastiques de haute précision au niveau mondial - L'emplacement vit par une équipe flexible et motivée avec une hiérarchie plate et de courts chemins de décision - Grâce à l'expansion continue de nos compétences dans le domaine du traitement des plastiques ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue de nos processus d'affaires, nous offrons à nos clients des solutions innovantes, fiables, individuelles et sûres pour vos préoccupations dans les segments production/distribution d'électricité, chemin de fer, espace, service et industrie - Nous vous fournirons ceci à des prix raisonnables, à temps dans la qualité souhaitée - Nous assurons notre compétitivité en automatisant et optimisant nos lignes de production afin de pouvoir répondre encore plus rapidement et de manière flexible aux besoins du marché mondial et des clients - Tu peux faire ça. Mansioni - Fonctionnement de la machine : Autoréglage et fonctionnement d'un parc de machines conventionnel complexe (y compris les fraiseuses à broches multiples, les meuleuses à cylindres, les scies à broches multiples, les fraiseuses et les machines de refroidissement) - Matériel d'essai et ébauches : installation et fonctionnement indépendants de matériel d'essai électrique et de divers systèmes de parage - Contrôle des commandes: Vous coordonnez et contrôlez les commandes de production indépendamment et vous assurez un traitement en temps opportun - Contrôle de qualité: Vous effectuez des contrôles de qualité réguliers sur les composants transformés – des pièces individuelles aux petites séries - Maintenance et entretien: vous prenez en charge l'entretien et l'entretien des machines utilisées et assurez leur disponibilité opérationnelle fiable - Surveillance des outils : vous surveillez l'utilisation des aides à la fabrication et assurez leur disponibilité et leur fonctionnalité - Transport & Logistique: Vous servez différents camions industriels et supporte ainsi un flux fluide de matériaux dans la production
• Requisiti - Formation complète en polymécanique, mécanicien industriel, constructeur de moules, charpentier ou dans une profession similaire avec une expérience pluriannuelle dans un poste comparable - Bonne connaissance allemande du mot et de l'écriture, connaissance anglaise de l'avantage - Vous êtes prêt pour l'équipe, travaillez de manière indépendante et apportez un haut degré de responsabilité - Vous avez une excellente compréhension des dessins techniques et des listes - Vous êtes flexible, montrez votre propre initiative et apportez une performance élevée - Pensée entrepreneuriale et orientation client prononcée vous caractérisent

descriptionByLocale.it:
Über die Position Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist technischer Marktführer in der Auslegung und Herstellung von Transformatoren-Durchführungen. Zu den Kunden zählen namhafte, internationale Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die sich mit Stromerzeugung, Stromübertragung und Stromverteilung befassen. Unsere Hochspannungs-Durchführungen nehmen weltweit eine Spitzenposition ein.  Das kannst Du bewirken Einrichtung und Bedienung von CNC- und konventionellen Drehmaschinen Erstellen der CNC Programme zu den Dreharbeiten Fertigen von Einzelteilen und Kleinserien Pflege und Wartung (VBI) der Maschinen und Anlagen Diverse 
• Aufgaben wie Qualitätsvorgaben einhalten, kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsprozess, konsequente Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheit Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Lehre als Polymechaniker\/in EFZ (oder auch Mechaniker\/in, Maschinenmechaniker\/in) Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich CNC-Drehen, konv. von Vorteil Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Exakte, ordentliche Arbeitsweise Bereitschaft zum Einsatz im 3 Schicht-Betrieb und flexibler Arbeitszeit Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Iscriviti al nostro Centro di Servizi Locali in Svizzera per una posizione dinamica che unisce la gestione dei progetti a responsabilità pratiche sul campo. In questo ruolo, supervisionerai i progetti di assistenza dei trasformatori di potenza dall'inizio alla fine, assicurandoti che tutti gli strumenti, le attrezzature e le procedure di calibrazione siano preparati con cura per operazioni sicure ed efficienti in loco. Entrando a far parte del nostro team, contribuirai direttamente alla stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con i principali attori del mercato energetico svizzero. Se ti piace gestire gli stakeholder tanto quanto rimboccarti le maniche per assicurarti che i team sul campo siano pronti all'azione, questo è il ruolo che fa per te. Si prega di inviare i vostri documenti in inglese. Come creare un impatto Lead e coordinare progetti di servizio trasformatori cross-funzionali dall'inizio all'altro, esecuzione in loco e chiusura, con piena responsabilità su tempistiche, costi, qualità, risorse e rischi Garantire disponibilità, conformità e affidabilità di strumenti, strumenti e apparecchiature di collaudo, inclusa manutenzione, calibrazione, certificazione e prontezza per le operazioni di servizio dei trasformatori Gestire e ottimizzare la logistica degli utensili e delle attrezzature, coprendo il controllo dell'inventario, Stoccaggio, rifornimento, spedizione, preparazione del materiale specifico per progetto e condivisione delle risorse tra i progetti Supportare i team sul campo con pacchetti completi, inclusi documentazione tecnica, procedure, requisiti di sicurezza e coordinamento onsite quando necessario Agire come interfaccia primaria tra clienti, team di assistenza sul campo, workshop, fornitori e stakeholder interni, garantendo una comunicazione chiara, proattiva e orientata alla soddisfazione durante tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto Pianifico, programma, e supervisionare le attività di servizio, garantendo la piena prontezza lavorativa prima della mobilitazione del sito, inclusi ambito tecnico, documentazione, permessi, accesso, logistica e prerequisiti HSE. Preparare e coordinare le attività in loco, garantire un'esecuzione sicura, fluida ed efficiente, e fornire supporto operativo operativo operativo durante situazioni critiche o complesse. Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi di progetto e operativi, garantendo la rigorosa conformità alle regole HSE, Standard ISO e requisiti normativi Favoriscono il miglioramento e la standardizzazione continui, migliorando la gestione degli strumenti, i processi di preparazione del sito e l'efficienza complessiva dell'esecuzione dei servizi Il tuo background Laurea in ingegneria, gestione tecnica o in un campo correlato 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti o nel coordinamento dei servizi sul campo Handson mentalità e forte interesse per strumenti, calibrazione, sicurezza e preparazione tecnica Solide competenze organizzative e comunicative Esperienza in standard di qualità (ad esempio, ISO): Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e assumersi la responsabilità dei compiti dall'inizio all'estremo, Affare fluente in francese e inglese; Il tedesco è un vantaggio Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le performance personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Join our Local Service Center Switzerland for a dynamic position that blends project management with hands-on field responsibilities. In this role, you will oversee power transformer service projects from start to finish, ensuring all tools, equipment, and calibration procedures are meticulously prepared for safe and efficient onsite operations. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the stability of Switzerland's electrical grid and have the opportunity to collaborate with key players in the Swiss energy market. If you enjoy managing stakeholders as much as rolling up your sleeves to make sure field teams are ready for action, this is the role for you. Please submit your documents in English. How You'll Make an Impact Lead and coordinate cross‑functional transformer service projects end‑to‑end, onsite execution, and close‑out, with full ownership of schedule, cost, quality, resources, and risks Ensure availability, compliance, and reliability of tools, instruments, and testing equipment, including maintenance, calibration, certification, and readiness for transformer service operations Manage and optimize tooling and equipment logistics, covering inventory control, storage, replenishment, shipment, project‑specific material preparation, and resource sharing across projects Support field teams with complete job packs, including technical documentation, procedures, safety requirements, and onsite coordination when required Act as the primary interface between customers, field service teams, workshops, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear, proactive, and satisfaction‑oriented communication throughout the project lifecycle Plan, schedule, and supervise service activities, ensuring full job readiness prior to site mobilization, including technical scope, documentation, permits, access, logistics, and HSE prerequisites Prepare and coordinate onsite activities, guarantee safe, smooth, and efficient execution, and providing hands‑on operational support during critical or complex situations Identify, escalate, and resolve project and operational risks, ensuring strict compliance with HSE rules, ISO standards, and regulatory requirements Drive continuous improvement and standardization, enhancing tooling management, site preparation processes, and overall service execution efficiency Your background Degree in engineering, technical management, or a related field 3+ years of project management or field service coordination experience Handson mindset and strong interest in tools, calibration, safety, and technical preparation Solid organizational and communication skills Experience with quality standards (e.g., ISO) Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks end-to-end Business fluent in French and fluent English; German is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit Treten Sie unserem lokalen Service-Center Schweiz für eine dynamische Position bei, die Projektmanagement mit praktischen
• Aufgaben vor Ort verbindet. In dieser Rolle beaufsichtigen Sie die Serviceprojekte für Leistungstransformatoren von Anfang bis Ende und stellen sicher, dass alle Werkzeuge, Geräte und Kalibrierungsverfahren sorgfältig auf einen sicheren und effizienten Betrieb vor Ort vorbereitet sind. Indem Sie sich unserem Team anschließen, tragen Sie direkt zur Stabilität des Schweizer Stromnetzes bei und haben die Möglichkeit, mit wichtigen Akteuren auf dem Schweizer Energiemarkt zusammenzuarbeiten. Wenn Sie Stakeholder genauso gerne verwalten wie die Ärmel hochkrempeln, um sicherzustellen, dass die Außendienstteams einsatzbereit sind, ist dies die richtige Rolle für Sie. Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Unterlagen in englischer Sprache ein. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen und koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Transformator-Serviceprojekte Ende-zu-Ende, Ausführung vor Ort und Abschluss, mit vollständiger Verantwortung für Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, Ressourcen und Risiken Stellen Sie die Verfügbarkeit, Konformität und Zuverlässigkeit von Werkzeugen, Instrumenten und Prüfgeräten sicher, einschließlich Wartung, Kalibrierung, Zertifizierung und Bereitschaft für den Transformator-Servicebetrieb Verwalten und optimieren Sie die Werkzeug- und Ausrüstungslogistik, einschließlich Bestandskontrolle, Lagerung, Nachschub, Versand, projektspezifische Materialvorbereitung und projektübergreifende Ressourcenteilung Unterstützen Sie Außendienstteams mit vollständigen Arbeitspaketen, einschließlich technischer Dokumentation, Verfahren, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Vor-Ort-Koordination bei Bedarf Handeln Sie als
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre Centre de services locaux Suisse pour une position dynamique qui combine la gestion de projet avec des responsabilités pratiques sur le terrain. Dans ce rôle, vous superviserez les projets de service de transformateurs de puissance du début à la fin, assurant que tous les outils, équipements et procédures d'étalonnage sont méticuleusement préparés pour des opérations sur place sûres et efficaces. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous contribuerez directement à la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez la possibilité de collaborer avec des acteurs clés du marché suisse de l'énergie. Si vous aimez gérer les parties prenantes autant que monter vos manches pour vous assurer que les équipes de terrain sont prêtes à agir, c'est le rôle pour vous. Veuillez soumettre vos documents en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez et coordonnez des projets de services de transformation transfonctionnels en anglais, de bout en bout, d'exécution sur place et de fermeture, avec pleine propriété du calendrier, du coût, de la qualité, des ressources et des risques Assurer la disponibilité, la conformité et la fiabilité des outils, des instruments et du matériel d'essai, y compris la maintenance, l'étalonnage, la certification et la préparation aux opérations de transformation Gérer et optimiser l'outillage et la logistique du matériel, y compris le contrôle des stocks, le stockage, la reconstitution, l'expédition, la préparation du matériel spécifique au projet et le partage des ressources entre les projets Soutenir les équipes de terrain avec des équipes de travail complètes, y compris la documentation technique, les procédures, les exigences en matière de sécurité et la coordination sur place au besoin Agir comme interface principale entre les clients, les équipes de services sur le terrain, les ateliers, les fournisseurs et les intervenants internes, assurer une communication claire, proactive et axée sur la satisfaction tout au long du cycle de vie du projet Plan, du calendrier et de la supervision des activités de service, assurer une pleine préparation au travail avant la mobilisation du site, y compris la documentation et les permis, l'accès.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione La possibilità di entrare a far parte di un team dedicato e assumersi la responsabilità di creare e gestire un parco macchine versatile ed esigente. Per processi lisci nella produzione, controlli gli ordini in modo autonomo, controlli di qualità e garantisci la disponibilità operativa delle macchine. Con know-how tecnico, iniziativa e spirito di squadra Contribuisci attivamente all'efficienza e allo sviluppo dei nostri processi produttivi. La nostra fabbrica di Klingnau è a disposizione dei nostri clienti come centro di competenza per la lavorazione di materie plastiche ad alta precisione a livello mondiale. La posizione vive da un team flessibile e motivato con una gerarchia piana e brevi percorsi decisionali. Attraverso la continua espansione delle nostre competenze nel campo della lavorazione delle materie plastiche e il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi aziendali, offriamo ai nostri clienti soluzioni innovative, affidabili, individuali e sicure per le vostre preoccupazioni nei segmenti generazione/distribuzione di potenza, ferrovia, spazio, servizio e industria. Forniamo questo a prezzi ragionevoli, nel tempo nella qualità desiderata. Garantiamo la nostra competitività attraverso l'automazione e l'ottimizzazione delle nostre linee di produzione per poter rispondere in modo ancora più rapido e flessibile alle esigenze globali del mercato e del cliente. Mansioni - Regolazione e funzionamento di un complesso parco macchine convenzionale (comprese le fresatrici multiportali, le rettificatrici a cilindro, le seghe multiforno, le fresatrici e le fresatrici) - installazione indipendente e funzionamento di apparecchiature di prova elettriche e vari sistemi di rifilatura - Controllo degli ordini: coordinare e controllare gli ordini di produzione in modo indipendente e garantire un'elaborazione tempestiva - Controllo qualità: si effettuano controlli di qualità regolari sui componenti lavorati – da singole parti a piccole serie - Manutenzione e manutenzione: si assume la manutenzione e la manutenzione delle macchine utilizzate e si assicura la loro disponibilità operativa affidabile - Monitoraggio degli strumenti: Tenere d'occhio l'uso degli aiuti di fabbricazione e garantire la loro disponibilità e funzionalità - Trasporti & Logistica: Si servono diversi camion industriali e quindi supporta un flusso liscio di materiali in produzione
• Requisiti - Formazione completa come meccanico polimeccanico, industriale, costruttore di stampi, falegname o in una professione simile - Esperienza pluriennale in una posizione comparabile - Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura - Conoscenza inglese del vantaggio - Teamability, autooccupazione e un elevato livello di responsabilità - Ottima comprensione dei disegni e delle liste tecniche - Flessibilità, iniziativa e prestazioni elevate Cosa? - Metodi di lavoro flessibili per ottimizzare le prestazioni professionali - Un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere le loro competenze - L'opportunità di contribuire attivamente all'efficienza e allo sviluppo dei nostri processi produttivi - Un ambiente di lavoro con una gerarchia piana e brevi percorsi decisionali - L'opportunità di sviluppare soluzioni innovative, affidabili, individuali e sicure per i nostri clienti Contatto - Altro su di noi
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione The possibility of becoming part of a dedicated team and assuming responsibility for setting up and operating a versatile and demanding machine park. For smooth processes in production, you control orders autonomously, perform quality checks and ensure the operational readiness of the machines. With technical know-how, initiative and team spirit You actively contribute to the efficiency and further development of our production processes. Our factory in Klingnau is available to our customers as a center of expertise for high-precision plastics processing at world level. The location lives by a flexible and motivated team with a flat hierarchy and short decision-making paths. Through the continuous expansion of our competencies in the field of plastics processing as well as the continuous improvement of our business processes, we offer our customers innovative, reliable, individual and safe solutions for your concerns in the segments power generation/distribution, railway, space, service and industry. We provide this at reasonable prices, on time in the desired quality. Descrizione La possibilité de faire partie d'une équipe dédiée et d'assumer la responsabilité de la mise en place et de l'exploitation d'un parc de machines polyvalent et exigeant. Pour des processus en douceur dans la production, vous contrôlez les commandes de manière autonome, effectuez des contrôles de qualité et assurez la préparation opérationnelle des machines. Avec savoir-faire technique, initiative et esprit d'équipe Vous contribuez activement à l'efficacité et au développement de nos processus de production. Notre usine à Klingnau est à la disposition de nos clients en tant que centre d'expertise pour le traitement des plastiques de haute précision au niveau mondial. L'emplacement vit par une équipe flexible et motivée avec une hiérarchie plate et de courts chemins de décision. Grâce à l'expansion continue de nos compétences dans le domaine du traitement des plastiques ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue de nos processus d'affaires, nous offrons à nos clients des solutions innovantes, fiables, individuelles et sûres pour vos préoccupations dans les segments production/distribution d'électricité, chemin de fer, espace, service et industrie. Nous le fournissons à des prix raisonnables, à temps dans la qualité souhaitée. Nous assurons notre compétitivité grâce à l'automatisation et à l'optimisation de nos lignes de production afin de pouvoir répondre encore plus rapidement et avec souplesse aux besoins du marché mondial et des clients. Mansioni - Auto-ajustement et fonctionnement d'un parc de machines conventionnel complexe (y compris les fraiseuses à broches multiples, les fraiseuses à cylindre, les scies à broches multiples, les fraiseuses et les fraiseuses) - installation et fonctionnement indépendants d'équipements d'essai électriques et de divers systèmes de parage - Contrôle des commandes: Vous coordonnez et contrôlez les commandes de production indépendamment et vous assurez un traitement en temps opportun - Contrôle de qualité: Vous effectuez des contrôles de qualité réguliers sur les composants transformés – des pièces individuelles aux petites séries - Maintenance et entretien: vous prenez en charge l'entretien et l'entretien des machines utilisées et assurez leur disponibilité opérationnelle fiable - Surveillance des outils : vous surveillez l'utilisation des aides à la fabrication et assurez leur disponibilité et leur fonctionnalité - Transport & Logistique: Vous servez différents camions industriels et supporte ainsi un flux fluide de matériaux dans la production
