• Cosa offriamo - Méthodes de travail flexibles pour optimiser vos performances professionnelles - Un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer et développer leurs compétences - L'occasion de contribuer activement à l'efficacité et au développement de nos processus de production - Un environnement de travail avec une hiérarchie plate et des chemins de décision courts - L'opportunité de développer des solutions innovantes, fiables, individuelles et sûres pour nos clients Contatto - Plus sur nous

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken English Team player and well organized Creative and able to work autonomously Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità: Come parte del team Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers, sarai responsabile dell'analisi aziendale per i principali progetti di digitalizzazione tra cui Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA e Matterport all'interno di 25 fabbriche nell'ambito del portafoglio. Contribuirai in modo interfunzionale collaborando con la funzione IT e i domini aziendali, oltre ad essere responsabile della progettazione, dello sviluppo e della manutenzione dei report di GPG DT Power BI per monitorare KPI e metriche delle prestazioni ## Mansioni - Garantire l'aderenza agli standard di governance dei dati e mantenere una documentazione completa per tutti i report e i processi all'interno dell'area digitale di GPG DT Operations - Raccogliere e progettare i requisiti aziendali nel formato e nei modelli di documentazione richiesti - Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi, gli strumenti e le metodologie di reporting per una maggiore efficienza e scalabilità - Implementare le migliori pratiche e sfruttare le tecnologie emergenti per migliorare le capacità di analisi dei dati - Fornire formazione e orientamento ai team aziendali sui report di analisi, strumenti digitali di base, strumento TrafoSignature - Collaborare con team globali, hub e fabbriche per raccogliere requisiti e fornire soluzioni di reporting personalizzate - Agire come collegamento chiave tra team tecnici e stakeholder aziendali per garantire allineamento e trasparenza - Condurre analisi funzionali e aziendali per i progetti principali: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport dal punto di vista aziendale - Eseguire l'utente
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics ## Mansioni - Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area - Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates - Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability - Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities - Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool - Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions - Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency - Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective - Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT - Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS ## Requisiti - Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field - Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments - Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling - Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate) - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders - Strong understanding of functional and business analysis - Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment ## Cosa offriamo - We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process - Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate - Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully - Applicable only for Poland location align with local law regulations
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die Chance: Als Teil des Teams der Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers sind Sie für die Geschäftsanalyse für zentrale Digitalisierungsprojekte wie Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA und Matterport in 25 Fabriken im Portfoliobereich verantwortlich. Sie leisten einen funktionsübergreifenden Beitrag, indem Sie mit IT-Funktionen und Geschäftsbereichen zusammenarbeiten und für das Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Pflegen der GPG DT Power BI-Berichte verantwortlich sind, um KPIs und Leistungsmetriken zu überwachen ## Mansioni - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Data-Governance-Standards und Pflege einer umfassenden Dokumentation für alle Berichte und Prozesse im digitalen Bereich von GPG DT Operations - Sammeln und Entwerfen von Geschäftsanforderungen in erforderlichen Dokumentationsformaten und -vorlagen - Ermittlung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Berichterstattungsprozessen, Tools und Methoden für mehr Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit - Implementierung von Best Practices und Nutzung neuer Technologien zur Verbesserung der Datenanalysefunktionen - Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Anleitungen für Geschäftsteams zu den Analyseberichten, zentralen digitalen Tools, TrafoSignature-Tool - Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Teams, HUBs und Fabriken, um Anforderungen zu erfassen und maßgeschneiderte Berichtslösungen zu liefern - Handeln als wichtige Verbindung zwischen technischen Teams und Geschäftsbeteiligten, um Ausrichtung und Transparenz zu gewährleisten - Leitung von Funktions- und Geschäftsanalysen für Kernprojekte: Digitale TrafoSignatur, ECS, IBA, Matterport aus Geschäftspersicht - Durchführung von Benutzerlösungen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione The Opportunity: Dans le cadre de l'équipe Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers, vous serez responsable de l'analyse d'affaires pour les projets de numérisation de base, y compris Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA et Matterport dans 25 usines dans le domaine du portefeuille. - Mettre en oeuvre les meilleures pratiques et tirer parti des nouvelles technologies pour améliorer les capacités d'analyse des données - Fournir de la formation et des conseils aux équipes d'affaires sur les rapports analytiques, les outils numériques de base, l'outil TrafoSignature - Collaborer avec les équipes mondiales, les HUB et les usines pour recueillir les exigences et fournir des solutions de rapport adaptées - Agir en tant que liaison clé entre les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes d'affaires pour assurer l'alignement et la transparence - Diriger l'analyse fonctionnelle et opérationnelle pour les projets de base : TrafoSignature numérique, ECS, IBA, Matterport du point de vue des entreprises - Effectuer des essais d'acceptation des utilisateurs et de la validation avec les utilisateurs clés et les TI - Fournir des mises à jour numériques sur le contenu du site Web de GPG DT Nous nous engageons à assurer la pleine transparence et le respect de toutes les exigences légales, en veillant à ce que chaque candidat sache exactement à quoi s'attendre à chaque étape du processus de recrutement - Une fois le processus mené à bien, nous partagerons des informations détaillées sur les conditions financières et les avantages financiers avec le candidat sélectionné - Avant de signer le contrat de travail, vous recevrez tous les détails restants de l'offre, vous donnant le temps et l'espace pour tout examiner soigneusement - Applicable uniquement pour l'emplacement de la Pologne en conformité avec la réglementation locale
